subject: Coordinating demo coverage for Polaris — demo coverage roster & prep
messages:
From: Nina Park <nina@polaris.io>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@polaris.io>, procurement@polaris.io
Date: 2026-09-11T08:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — multi-region coverage question

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We have a cross-functional group that needs to see the platform (eng + security + procurement). Can we lock a 90-minute session that covers: 1) live feature demo, 2) security design Q&A, 3) procurement timeline / billing questions?

Our team spans US, EU and APAC — ideal overlap is narrow. Rough availability from our side next week:
- US: Tue/Thu 09:00–12:00 PT
- EU: Tue/Wed 14:00–18:00 CET
- APAC: Wed/Thu 09:00–13:00 SGT

Can you suggest slots that let us bring Eng + Security and also have an AE + SE present? If you have an internal proposal for rotating coverage for future sessions (we're likely to run weekly short demos after this initial deep dive), please include.

Nina
Nina Park
Lead, Platform Engineering | Polaris Systems
From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Nina Park <nina@polaris.io>, Oliver Grant <oliver@polaris.io>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, procurement@polaris.io
Date: 2026-09-11T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — multi-region coverage question

Hi Nina / Oliver —

Appreciate the availability. I've attached a short agenda and a timezone-overlap grid to make picking a slot easier (attachment: polaris-demo-agenda.pdf, timezone-overlap-grid.xlsx). Suggested 90-minute windows that maximize coverage with an AE + SE + security rep:

Option A — Tue 2026-09-15 16:00–17:30 CEST / 07:00–08:30 PT / 23:00–00:30 SGT (works if APAC can join late)
Option B — Wed 2026-09-16 09:00–10:30 PT / 18:00–19:30 CEST / 01:00–02:30 SGT (better for US/EU; APAC may join asynchronously)
Option C — Thu 2026-09-17 14:00–15:30 CEST / 05:00–06:30 PT / 21:00–22:30 SGT (middle-ground shift)

If you need strict synchronous coverage of Eng+Security in all three regions, we can do a paired-handover: run one deep demo timed for US/EU overlap and schedule a short APAC-focused repeat (30–45 min) within 24 hours where the SE will present region-specific infra/latency concerns. We can propose a recurring roster where SE coverage rotates to match your preferred local times — see the attached grid.

Priya Natarajan (cc'd) will help with any procurement/start-up paperwork and invoicing cadence.

Next steps: pick one of the options above or propose 1–2 times from your end and we'll lock it. Also let me know who from Security should be on the call (name + title) so we can include the right internal SME.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Nina Park <nina@polaris.io>, Oliver Grant <oliver@polaris.io>
Date: 2026-09-11T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — multi-region coverage question

Rachel / Nina —

Quick technical note from the SE side: for a 90-minute session that includes a deep-dive on deployment, observability, and security controls, I recommend the following internal coverage plan:

- We (SEs) can cover Option A and Option C without extra prep — I'll take the live infra/latency demo and the KV/cache behavior walkthrough.
- For Option B (US-focused morning), I can lead the demo but will need a secondary SE to pick up the APAC-focused repeat (I can do a recorded short handoff if a second SE isn't available).
- For anything starting after 22:00 SGT, we'll ask to keep the hands-on infra discussion to 30–40 minutes and move deeper compliance questions to a follow-up with our Security SME (to avoid late-night on-call).

I can block the following provisional SE shifts:
- Mon/Tue 05:30–09:30 PT (covers early US / late APAC overlap)
- Wed/Thu 15:00–19:00 CEST (covers EU peak)

If you confirm a slot, I'll upload a short runbook snippet to the shared Drive and include the demo notebook.

— Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: procurement@polaris.io
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nina Park <nina@polaris.io>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — procurement window and PO timing

Hi Rachel / Priya —

Procurement here — quick logistics: once we have a demo date, we need a short commercial summary (SKU/estimate, billing contact, billing address) and the procurement window for pilot pricing. Our typical PO lead time is 7–10 business days after demo acceptance.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood offers net-30 on pilot invoices or if you require prepayment for Dedicated trials?

Thanks,
Procurement Team | Polaris Systems
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: procurement@polaris.io, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-12T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — procurement window and PO timing

Hi —

Thanks for the heads up. We can provide a one-page commercial summary after the demo is scheduled; I'll draft the SKU estimate and send it by EOD the business day after the demo. For pilot customers we typically offer net-30 terms; if Polaris needs prepayment we can escalate to Sales Ops for an exception.

Laura — I'm cc'ing you for awareness in case we need an approval on any prepayment exception or promotional demo credits.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Nina Park <nina@polaris.io>

Thanks everyone —

We're going to take Option A (Tue 2026-09-15 16:00–17:30 CEST / 07:00–08:30 PT / 23:00–00:30 SGT). Attendees confirmed:
- Nina Park — Lead, Platform Eng (host)
- Oliver Grant — Security Architect
- Priya Shen — Procurement (procurement@polaris.io)

If possible, please add a calendar invite with dial-in and the shared Drive prep folder. We'll need the commercial summary within one business day after the demo.

Thanks — looking forward.
Nina
